entries.name: Hospital Veterinario San Juan Roosevelt
entries.address: Calzada San Juan 8-61, Ciudad de Guatemala
entries.duty: 24-hour emergency care, 365 days a year including holidays: +502 2375 8700. Outpatient consultations 7:00-18:00; emergency hours from 18:00. Ambulance daytime only.
entries.note: Page headline 'Emergencias veterinarias 24 horas'; FAQ 'Atendemos 24/7, incluyendo dias festivos'; staff physically present 24 h. Daytime emergency line 5518-8301; 24 h pharmacy 5555-8004.

duty_i18n.pt: Urgências 24 horas por dia, 365 dias por ano, incluindo feriados: +502 2375 8700. Consultas externas 7h00–18h00; horário de urgências a partir das 18h00. Ambulância só durante o dia.

entries.name: VETMAS
entries.duty: Urgent veterinary cases attended at any hour. Phone/WhatsApp +502 4363 4958, also +502 2394 9324. Call to confirm.
entries.note: Page title 'Emergencias Veterinarias 24 Horas en Zona 10 | VETMAS'; text 'Atencion de urgencias veterinarias a cualquier hora'. Address on page is Zona 7 though the title says Zona 10; the Zona 16 (aves) page also does not give 24 h. No opening hours published.

notes: Research 2026-11-13; all source_urls opened with WebFetch. Official bodies (Colegio de Medicos Veterinarios y Zootecnistas de Guatemala, MAGA, USAC FMVZ hospital) not reachable with a usable clinic list: search surfaced only PDFs/news, WebFetch refused un-surfaced URLs (portal.fmvz.usac.edu.gt blocked by provenance rule); an emisorasunidas.com article on the USAC hospital has no address/phone. No duty rota and no animal poison line found. veterinariasanpedro.gt blocked by robots (not used). Not added for lack of own-page confirmation: AmbuPet (home service, 24/7, phone 3285-4838), Ortovet (home service 24 h, phone 2316-4134), PAWS, Veterinaria San Pedro - all only on the Vet IT SOS list. No Antigua, Quetzaltenango, Atitlan or Flores clinics found with own pages. Left to do: official college directory, USAC hospital page, regional clinics.
